# Vendored game: Jurassic Runner

The game engine in this directory is **unmodified** and is vendored for headless
driving. It is the "Jurassic Runner" sample (the three-lane, jump/duck/lane-switch
endless runner inside `pocs/jurassic-runner-game/web/`) from the repo:

- Repository: `diegopacheco/ai-playground`
- Path: `pocs/jurassic-runner-game/web/`
- Pinned commit: `d3bb4e127ec350af1964e315a8c9c2624210ca4e`
- Files: `game.js`, `audio.js`, `index.html`, `style.css` (plus provenance/design docs)
